A small lab with a wide horizon.

Toumiō Labs builds AI products focused on useful, personal and expressive interaction between people and machines.

How we work

Make the useful thing feel good to use.

We care about the details between a person and a system: the space around a response, the shape of a workspace, the quality of a voice, the feeling of being understood without being over-directed.

Our products

MoCHi is our primary product: a personal AI workspace built around user-controlled providers. Haven is an emerging voice system for expressive AI speech and conversational experiences.
